about: Ionity Business Mind Map (IBMM) | Policy 986 AED | License AED 900. Twenty field notes for the seeded Highveld farm (services/brain/tests/farm.py). 'node' is the key of the expected target; a channel child of it (Maintenance, Health Alerts) also counts. 'expect' lists action types that must appear. Phase 1 exit: at least 85 % right first time.

notes.text: One of the ewes in the south paddock broke her back left leg
The John Deere tractor's hydraulic hose just burst near the bean fields
Just finished planting the last two hundred hectares of beans
The main water pump is leaking badly
Die groot pomp lek weer by die flens
Ask Sipho to fix the north fence tomorrow
Vra Sipho om die trekker se olie te verander voor Vrydag
Dipped all the ewes this morning, no problems
Two cows are limping, the vet must look at them
Centre pivot 2 is making a grinding noise
We need to order more diesel for the tractors
Die beeste is in die suid kamp geskuif
Borehole pump pressure is low again
Sipho fixed the fence by the south paddock
The bean planting log is up to date, 3000 hectares done
Remember to service the John Deere next week
One of the rams got out through the north fence
Die skape het vandag water gekry by die suid kamp
The pivot finished irrigating the beans, and the main pump is running fine now
A calf was born last night, healthy and strong
